panels.title: Pipeline flow
panels.description: Live per-stage packet counts (main stat), average seconds (secondary stat), and outcome arcs: green ok, red error, yellow skipped

targets.rawSql: WITH stages(stage, ord) AS (VALUES ('produce', 1), ('parse', 2), ('categorize', 3), ('inject', 4)), agg AS (SELECT stage, count(*) AS packets, avg(extract(epoch FROM exited_at - entered_at)) AS avg_s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'ok')::float / count(*) AS ok_frac, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'error')::float / count(*) AS err_frac, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'skipped')::float / count(*) AS skip_frac FROM pipeline_lineage WHERE $__timeFilter(entered_at) GROUP BY stage) SELECT s.stage AS id, s.stage AS title, coalesce(a.packets, 0) AS mainstat, round(coalesce(a.avg_s, 0)::numeric, 2) AS secondarystat, coalesce(a.ok_frac, 0) AS arc__ok, coalesce(a.err_frac, 0) AS arc__error, coalesce(a.skip_frac, 0) AS arc__skipped FROM stages s LEFT JOIN agg a USING (stage) ORDER BY s.ord

WITH pairs(id, source, target) AS (VALUES ('produce-parse', 'produce', 'parse'), ('parse-categorize', 'parse', 'categorize'), ('categorize-inject', 'categorize', 'inject')), arrivals AS (SELECT stage, count(*) AS packets FROM pipeline_lineage WHERE $__timeFilter(entered_at) AND stage IN ('parse', 'categorize', 'inject') GROUP BY stage) SELECT p.id, p.source, p.target, coalesce(a.packets, 0) AS mainstat FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN arrivals a ON a.stage = p.target ORDER BY p.id

SELECT stage, count(*) AS packets, round(avg(extract(epoch FROM exited_at - entered_at))::numeric, 2) AS avg_seconds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'error') AS errors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'skipped') AS skipped, max(coalesce(exited_at, entered_at)) AS last_activity FROM pipeline_lineage WHERE $__timeFilter(entered_at) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['produce','parse','categorize','inject'], stage)

SELECT stage, extract(epoch FROM now() - max(coalesce(exited_at, entered_at))) AS seconds FROM pipeline_lineage GROUP BY stage ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['produce','parse','categorize','inject'], stage)

options.content:
```
arxiv content          s2 / hf / bluesky / hn signals       arxiv html fulltext
      |                              |                              |
produce-content (1h)        produce-signals (6h)         produce-fulltext (15m x25)
      |                              |                              |
      +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                     |
                                rs.raw.v1                 kafka :9092 (kraft single node)
                                     |
    decode -> parse -> tap rs.parsed.v1 -> categorize -> inject -> tap rs.enriched.v1
                bytewax worker (recovery .local/stream-recovery, at-least-once + upserts)
                                     |
      postgres :5432   papers / embeddings / chunks / signals / pipeline_lineage
                                     |
      api :8000 (/v1, /v1/stream/stats)    web :4321    scheduler (digest / topics / report)
```

Every packet carries produce, parse, categorize, and inject lineage stamps; this dashboard and the Pipeline and Traces dashboards read them from the pipeline_lineage table and the pipeline_rollups_hourly view. Lineage is pruned at 30 days by the daily report task.
